NIA

A structured base for tracking business opportunities.

Who is it for?

My business, with an approach that can inspire a bespoke sales system.

The problem to solve

Opportunities arrive through different channels and follow-ups become difficult to track.

The planned experience

  • 01Linked opportunities and prospects
  • 02Actions, follow-ups and offer catalog
  • 03Sources and NIA activity log
  • 04Human approval fields

The story behind it

While I build my projects, I want to spot and track opportunities better. NIA was created to support that business development.

In preparation

Where does it stand?

Updated: 1 November 2026

Dedicated Airtable base and Make scenario created, with Gmail and Airtable connections. Qualification filters and message mapping are being configured and tested; full autonomy is not yet confirmed.
